data.narrative:
Lyten is a Series C-stage climate and energy company that has raised $1.33B to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public frontier-tech company in the Climate & Energy sector, including peers at similar stage such as KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $1.33B total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $2.3B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comps produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The peer approach reflects material dispersion in how the market values early-stage climate-tech companies.

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $850M (low) to $2.6B (high), with a median of $1.6B. This 3x spread reflects structural uncertainty in frontier-tech valuation: heterogeneous technology maturity, variable path-to-revenue visibility, and sparse late-stage comparables. Key sensitivities include near-term commercial deployment milestones, capital efficiency relative to peers, and commodity or energy-price correlation that may affect end-market demand.
